d:
Mauritius has a deep cultural and spiritual connection with India .
In this video, we explore the India–Mauritius connection through the sacred Ganga Talao, also known as Grand Bassin.
This holy lake is considered an extension of the River Ganga, and it is home to the majestic Lord Shiva Statue, Durga Mata Statue, and the peaceful Hanuman Mandir.
Millions of devotees visit this place every year, making it one of the most important Hindu pilgrimage sites outside India.
We explore:
The majestic Ganga Talao
The massive Lord Shiva Statue
The powerful Durga Mata Statue
